title: L0: Owner confirms Amazon Reviews 2023 license/terms
description:
## Owner decision needed

**Do you accept the McAuley Lab "Amazon Reviews 2023" (Hugging Face `McAuley-Lab/Amazon-Reviews-2023`) license/terms for this internal study, and approve the download?** The dataset card asks only for citation; license is UNVERIFIED. Also: may we store Amazon Community Guidelines / customer-review help pages under `var/policy/raw/` (not redistributed; commit only sha256 + own-words summary)?

## Scope

Read-only check of the dataset card / terms and the guideline pages; summarize for the owner. No download until the owner says yes.

## Definition of done

Owner's answer recorded verbatim as a comment; this issue closed; step 1 (loader) data work unblocked. If the owner says no: stop and pick another domain (epic "What result changes what we build").

## Cost

$0.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Owner approved downloading a ~3,000-review research sample of Amazon Reviews 2023 (no stated license; citation requested), kept out of git (2026-10-02).
